description: This file defines the class AdoNetFormatProvider which implements IFormatProvider for formatting .NET types for database storage, including an internal AdoNetFormatter class implementing ICustomFormatter.

classes.name: AdoNetFormatProvider
classes.description: Implements IFormatProvider to provide custom formatting for database storage.

classes.name: AdoNetFormatter
classes.description: Internal class implementing ICustomFormatter to format individual object types.

methods.name: GetFormat
methods.description: Returns the formatter object if the requested type is ICustomFormatter.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats given objects into database-compatible string representations.
